; ghostbuster-automated.qmd - full screen refresh on its own, at the moments
; where ghosting is left behind. Each event restarts a short timer, so the
; refresh happens once, after the screen has finished drawing. Every trigger
; writes "gba: <event>" to the xochitl journal, to see which one fired.
; Events:
;   settings opened                    (Settings.qml, onOpened)
;   loading indicator went away after it was drawn (Loading.qml, hide)
;   PIN accepted                       (MainView.qml, passcodeHandler.userLocked)
;   library got input focus back for the first time after waking up or after
;   xochitl start, that is after the PIN screen (Navigator.qml: BatteryManager,
;   activeFocus)
;   page turn that took long to draw   (DocumentView.qml: currentPage, isLoading);
;   toolbar panel closed               (ToolbarFoldout.qml, visible)
;   toolbar hidden or collapsed        (DocumentView.qml: toolbar.shown, expanded)
;                                       heavy pages (graphics-rich PDFs) leave
;                                       ghosting, quick ones are left alone
; Source: ghostbuster-automated.qmd.in, encoded by Tools\Remarkable\encode-qmd.py.
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only. Built for firmware 3.29.1.

; Document: a page turn that took long to draw. The time from the page change
; to the end of loading (tiles rendered) is measured; above gbaSlowTurnMs the
; screen is refreshed. Every turn writes its time to the journal, to tune the
; threshold.
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    IMPORT [[197082280.8400022150001312063]] 1.0
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&197088788&~ gbaSlowTurnMs: 400
            property ~&7082585429636&~ gbaTurnAt: 0

            ~&233681166222244&~ {
                ~&7083194890448&~: ~&12173585954242770596&~
                property: "gbaSelfRefresh"
                ~&214644635174&~: ~&214625660372&~
            }

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: gbaTurnTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 700
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
                }
            }

            ~&428051690305612204&~ {
                ~&7083194890448&~: ~&6504254477&~
                function ~&2104365313657427216&~() {
                    ~&6504254477&~.gbaTurnAt = ~&6502586279&~.now();
                }
                function onIsLoadingChanged() {
                    ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.~&254534022647302435&~ || ~&6504254477&~.gbaTurnAt <= 0) {
                        ~&7083121450889&~;
                    }
                    ~&214622607920&~ took = ~&6502586279&~.now() - ~&6504254477&~.gbaTurnAt;
                    ~&6504254477&~.gbaTurnAt = 0;
                    ~&214622607920&~ slow = took > ~&6504254477&~.gbaSlowTurnMs;
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~("gba: page turn " + took + " ms" + (slow ? ", refresh" : ""));
                    ~&5972376&~ (slow) {
                        gbaTurnTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; gbaSelfRefresh: the document view turns it off for its own indicator and
; refreshes once together with the page turn.
; Loading indicator (the dots in the middle of the screen) went away after it
; was actually drawn. Patched in the indicator itself, so it covers every place
; that shows one. The indicator draws only after a delay, so a quick open with
; no dots on screen gets no refresh.
AFFECT [[9475861978899727926]]
    IMPORT [[197082280.8400022150001312063]] 1.0
    TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&6503679477&~ gbaDrawn: ~&214625660372&~
            property ~&6503679477&~ gbaSelfRefresh: ~&6504329801&~

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: gbaSpinnerTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 1000
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~("gba: loading indicator gone");
                    ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
                }
            }
        }

        ; visualRoot.visible can not tell: by the time hide() runs the whole
        ; indicator is already invisible, and QML reports the child invisible too.
        ; So show() sets a flag of our own.
        REBUILD [[6504282794]]
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM \~&254549096489661813&~.~&214641748151&~();\ INSERT STREAM \ ~&6504254477&~.gbaDrawn = ~&6504329801&~;\
        END REBUILD

        REBUILD [[6503888195]]
            LOCATE BEFORE STREAM \~&4493576835535729955&~.~&6504295855&~();\ INSERT STREAM \ ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.gbaDrawn) { ~&6504254477&~.gbaDrawn = ~&214625660372&~; ~&5972376&~ (~&6504254477&~.gbaSelfRefresh) gbaSpinnerTimer.~&233743006639214&~(); }\
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
